headline: Updates on Community Preservation Committee park projects including Balch Playground, Holcroft Park Splashpad, and Gillis Park Pavilion.
summary: The commission will review Director's and Assistant Director's reports, including budget updates and project updates on Community Preservation Committee Round 12 and Round 13 projects. Commission members will also give reports on BG&T, Community Preservation Committee, and Open Space & Recreation Commission.
